_readme: VIGIL v2 protocols. Every behaviour of the app is a fixed rule from this file plus the user's MY TIMES. Edit it only with Claude Code; spec/PROTOCOLS.md documents every field. The core unit test BundledProtocolsTest fails on any error, so a bad edit never ships.

pool._note: One shared counter for all of these apps (v2.1): daily_budget_min minutes a day, at any time nothing else blocks the pool (a protocol's lock, the night lock, friends or walking, a bail-out penalty). Every open waits wait_min minutes first. One session of heavy_use.continuous_min minutes closes the app (ENOUGH FOR NOW) for a break_min break. all_browsers adds every installed browser (apps that open https links).

steps.text: Wudu, then pray.
Done.
Quiet time until the lock ends: dhikr or sit still. Then straight back to bed.

protocols._note: Starts when the wake alarm is dismissed. Pool lock: the screen is free, the morning card shows the step and opens the takeover. The pool stays blocked until every step is done.

Sun in your eyes: stand at a window or outside.
Bathroom and brush.

Breakfast: cook, eat, clean.
Chores.
Walk. On class days the commute is the walk.

protocols._note: Right after the Dhuhr lock ends (Fridays: the Jummah lock) + offset_min; a class in progress or another protocol on the screen makes it wait, and if it cannot start within 2 hours it is skipped (not a miss). The look lasts 3 minutes on the first 2 days it is done in full, then 1 minute more every 2 such days, up to 10. VIGIL's sounds stop; a soft chime at the end (QUIET silences it).

Phone face-down.
Look at one spot. No input, no sound.

protocols._note: Each MY TIMES study row (its length = end - start, or its minutes; its label = what to study), or START STUDY on home (50, 100 or 150 min). The rounds step becomes 50-minute work rounds with 10-minute breaks that fill the block exactly; the last round is cut to fit. The screen stays locked (APPS: PoliTO, WhatsApp, calls); every round and break ends with a soft chime (QUIET silences it).

Open the book or laptop.
Open the one study material for this block.
Work. Only this material.
steps.break_text: Break: stand up, drink water, look out a window. The phone stays locked.

steps.text: Close: one line on what you did.

protocols._note: Each MY TIMES gym row (its minutes, or start to end = the planned workout). Pool lock: the phone stays usable and the notification leads back. The workout pre-fills each exercise with the last reps and weight; a rest timer (rest_s, or the exercise's own) follows every set. Edit exercises to change the list; more can be added by name in the app.

steps.text: Change clothes, shoes on.
Pack the bag: water, towel.
Leave now. The gym is about 5 minutes away.
Workout. Log every set.
Back home: shower.

protocols._note: Wind-down an hour before tonight's target bedtime (sleep shifting: from MY TIMES bedtime start, 20 min earlier each night until the goal). GOING TO SLEEP ends the day and starts the night lock until the wake alarm.
protocols.title: WIND-DOWN

steps.text: Close the day: three lines on how the day went.
Tomorrow: your top 3 tasks and its first block. They become tomorrow's to-dos.
Prep: clothes out, bag packed, water by the bed, alarm checked.
Hygiene: brush your teeth, wash your face.
Phone away: plug it in across the room, out of arm's reach.
Lights low. White noise if you want it, then lights off.
GOING TO SLEEP. The day ends here.

protocols._note: Fridays, instead of the Dhuhr protocol (a missed Jummah brings Dhuhr back). Times from MY TIMES: leave by the first Friday class (or the lock) minus the commute minus 15 min; I'M AT UNI from 15 min before it, again every 10 min; a silent card 5 min before the last class that ends by jummah_time; the lock (Do Not Disturb, pool blocked, subtle screen) from jummah_time - 5 for 45 min, DONE from 15 min into it; missed at jummah_time + 50. Thursday's wind-down adds the prep to-do; Friday's morning has the shower.
protocols.title: JUMMAH

steps.text: Shoes on.
Bag: clean clothes on, bag packed.
Leave now. Maps is under APPS.
Walking on: no feeds on the way.
I'M AT UNI.
Jummah. The phone is silent. Tap DONE after the prayer.

prep_todos: Jummah prep: clean clothes, bag packed.

protocols._note: The home RESET button, or offered (START / NOT NOW) after 2 missed or left protocols in a row and after a missed Jummah. No penalty to start, no stage change; leaving early is a normal bail-out. Re-enter drops what was missed today and goes to the next thing.
protocols.title: RESET

steps.text: Stop: phone down, drink a glass of water.
Name it: one line on what derailed the day. Optional; it goes in the report.
Body: wash your face. Make wudu if a prayer is near.
Space: tidy the room.
Move: walk, or stand outside.
Re-enter: what was missed is dropped. Go to the next thing.

short.text: Stop: phone down, drink a glass of water.
Body: wash your face. Make wudu if a prayer is near.
Re-enter: what was missed is dropped. Go to the next thing.

minimal.text: Re-enter: what was missed is dropped. Go to the next thing.

single.text: A glass of water, then re-enter: go to the next thing.

protocols._note: LATER on home or on VIGIL's notification: one line and 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes. At the time: a full takeover with exactly the line (DONE, one SNOOZE of half the time, ON IT), then the pool stays locked until DONE. Ends at DONE, LEAVE (the usual penalty) or the day end.
protocols.title: PROMISE

steps.text: Do what you said you would.

protocols._note: I'M WALKING on home, and by itself at every MY TIMES commute row (for its minutes) and at Jummah's walking step. Only the pool is blocked: Maps, WhatsApp, calls and every other app stay usable. No prompts, no takeovers. Ends when the switch goes off (home, or STOP on its notification), after still_end_min without steps, or without a step counter at the commute's end + commute_grace_min (a manual walk: manual_max_min).
protocols.title: WALK

steps.text: Phone in your pocket.
Pool blocked. Maps, WhatsApp and calls stay allowed; audio only from VIGIL.
Walk. Look around: no prompts, no takeovers.

protocols._note: I'M WITH FRIENDS on home: the pool is blocked with no wait ("YOU'RE WITH FRIENDS") until the switch goes off, cap_min at most. Calls, Maps, WhatsApp and the PoliTO app stay usable. Subtle and quiet: no takeover.
protocols.title: FRIENDS

steps.text: You're with friends. The pool is blocked; calls, Maps and WhatsApp stay allowed.

protocols._note: One run per MY TIMES calls row (label = who, start = the card, end = the deadline, 16:00 by default; minutes = wrap-up after, 20 by default). A full card with the name: CALL opens the dialer, NOT NOW closes it. DONE appears after a call of min_call_min since the card appeared; nothing done after return_after_min: the card comes back once. Not done by the deadline: missed. Short = send a message instead (DONE at once).
protocols.title: CALL

steps.text: Tap CALL. DONE appears after a call of 3 minutes.

short.text: Send a message instead: tap MESSAGE, then DONE.

protocols._note: Off since v2.1 (per_day 0 and no move_nudges): no nudge fires by itself; TEST can still show one. Wellness nudges: per_day short takeovers at times that feel random (fixed per day), from wake + after_wake_min until the wind-down, at least min_gap_min apart, each seconds long; and a movement nudge after still_min without steps while the phone is in use. Only while the phone is in use and nothing else is going on (no run, class, QUIET, night lock, call, friends or walking): otherwise skipped. NOT OKAY or LEAVE end one at no cost; never a miss.
protocols.title: NUDGE

steps.text: Drink a glass of water.

nudges: Look at something far away for 20 seconds.
